description: Synthetic lightning-escalation scenario for offline demonstrations: a storm approaches Bishan Park Landscaping (1.3622, 103.8455) from ~15km (advisory) to ~4km (stop-work), then stops producing strikes. Each strike is replayed relative to the real clock, not these baked-in dates, so the escalation always plays out as if it just started — see FixtureNeaLightningClient. The stop-work hold then expires the normal way: once app.lightning.risk.validity-window has passed in real time since the last qualifying strike.
